title: Payroll
overviewDescription: Review persisted payroll results for the active administration.
runsDescription: Browse saved payroll runs and open an employee reconciliation.
persistedOnly: Results shown here come from saved calculation runs.
empty: No payroll runs are available for this administration.
runHashesHint: Calculation values and hashes are shown in the run reconciliation.
finalized: Finalized result. Artifacts are bound to this run.
notFinalized: This run has no finalized lifecycle event.
correctionsDescription: Review multiple persisted input versions for the same employee and period.
noCorrections: No runs with a changed source snapshot were found in the current history window.
compareDescription: Compare a persisted LiquidHR result with manually entered values from another payroll system.
externalComparisonReadOnly: External values are held in this browser view and cannot change the saved payroll result.
manualComparisonHint: Enter non-negative amounts using a decimal point or comma. Blank values are not compared.
arrangementsDescription: View payroll arrangements and component definitions for {administration}.
arrangementCatalogDescription: Open the scoped arrangement catalog and its effective versions.
componentCatalogDescription: Inspect persisted component definitions and their package provenance.
settingsDescription: View payroll capability and access for the active administration.
settingsScopeNotice: Settings are resolved from the signed-in administration context.
noFinalizedSalary: No finalized salary statement is available yet.
pensionExplanationText: The amounts below come from the saved calculation for this period. A missing amount is not treated as zero.
selfServicePrivacy: This view shows only your own finalized payroll amounts.
noPersistedInputs: No separate input values were saved for this step.
noComponentTrace: No separate engine step was saved; the component result and version above come from the persisted calculation.
formulaNotRecorded: No separate formula text was saved for this step.
formulaGrossWage: Contractual salary plus the persisted variable wage components.
formulaTaxableWage: The separately persisted wage-tax assessment base.
formulaWageTaxTable: Lookup in the persisted wage tax table using the displayed table and period inputs.
formulaEmployerInsurance: Sum of the separately persisted AWf, Aof, Whk, Wko and Zvw contributions.
formulaNetPay: Taxable wage less wage tax and any applicable other deductions.
formulaReserve: Persisted reserve rate applied to the displayed wage base.
formulaCumulative: Opening balance plus the reserve accrued in this period.
formulaTotalEmployerCost: Gross pay plus employer contributions, employer pension, reserves and other employer costs.
assessmentBaseTimesRate: Assessment base × percentage ÷ 100; the saved result and rounding are shown in the engine trace.
employeeReconciliationFormula: Contractual salary and variable payments make up gross pay. Pension and other pre-tax deductions feed the applicable fiscal assessment bases; wage tax and any post-tax deductions lead to net pay. The separate persisted amounts are shown below.
employerReconciliationFormula: Gross pay + employer insurance contributions + employer pension + holiday reserve + year-end reserve + other employer costs = total employer cost.
conceptStatus: Concept — the run succeeded but is not finalized. It is not a finalized payslip.
pensionReadinessWarning: The pension calculation is saved, but the readiness control is warning. This is deterministic TEST evidence; existing finalization requirements still apply.
pensionSourceVerificationRequired: Pension not calculated / source verification required.
netNotDefinitive: The displayed net pay is not definitive while the pension source is missing.
PAYRUN01-CTRL-009-PENSION-RULE-READY: Pension rule still needs source verification
grossToNetIntro: Gross pay is the starting point. Employee pension and applicable pre-tax deductions feed the separate assessment bases; wage tax and any other deductions lead to net pay. All amounts shown come from your finalized salary calculation.
essPensionSourceGap: Pension was not calculated; source verification is required.
essPensionReview: Your pension contribution is saved, but the source check needs review.
